llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must derive an explicit dirty state for the edit form (for example comparing current input vs last saved value) and only block leaving when that state is dirty.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Dirty state is derived by comparing `name !== savedName`; the listener only blocks removal when that condition is true.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must intercept native-stack back/remove actions with `usePreventRemove(...)` on the edit screen.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Back/remove actions are intercepted via `navigation.addListener('beforeRemove', ...)`, not via the required `usePreventRemove(...)` hook from React Navigation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must show an explicit confirmation choice when leaving with unsaved changes and resume on confirm (for example by dispatching `data.action`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: An Alert dialog is shown with a 'Discard' option that calls `navigation.dispatch(e.data.action)` to resume navigation on confirmation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must allow leaving the edit screen without a confirmation prompt when there are no unsaved changes.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: When `name === savedName`, the listener returns early without calling `e.preventDefault()`, allowing navigation to proceed without any prompt.
